name: Trestle
summary: Phone validation, caller identification and lead-contact grading (phone, email, address, IP) from Trestle's identity data.

api_key.description: a Trestle API key (sign up and manage keys at portal.trestleiq.com)

notes: Every call is a GET with the key in the x-api-key header.
Problems with the input come back as warnings on a 200 response, not as a 400.
Add-ons (litigator_checks, spam_checks, email_checks_deliverability, email_checks_age) are comma-separated in add_ons and cost extra.
Trestle data is not a consumer report: do not use it for credit, insurance, employment, housing or benefits decisions.
The docs also list reverse phone, reverse address, address validation, smart CNAM, phone feedback and decision signals APIs, which this entry leaves out.

endpoints.name: Validate a phone number
endpoints.summary: Validity, carrier, line type, prepaid flag, country and a 0-100 activity score.

phone.description: Phone number in E.164 or local format.

country_hint.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country of the number, used to read a local-format number.

source_id.description: Groups queries by source, campaign or channel; up to 255 characters of letters, numbers, spaces and . _ - : / | #. An invalid value is dropped, not an error.

notes: A low activity score points to a disconnected number.

endpoints.name: Identify the top owner of a phone number
endpoints.summary: Line type, carrier, and the highest-ranked owner with their current address.

phone.description: Phone number in E.164 or local format; default country calling code is +1.

country_hint.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country of the number.

name_hint.description: Name linked to the phone; ranks the matching owner higher.

postal_code_hint.description: Postal code of the subscriber address; ranks the matching owner and address higher.

source_id.description: Groups queries by source, campaign or channel; up to 255 characters of letters, numbers, spaces and . _ - : / | #. An invalid value is dropped, not an error.

notes: US-focused data; returns only the best-ranked owner.

endpoints.name: Verify and grade a lead's contact details
endpoints.summary: A-F grades and activity scores across name, phone, email, address and IP, with name-match flags and IP trust signals.

state_code.description: Two-letter state code or full state name.

country_code.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country of the address.

ip_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address captured when the lead submitted the form.

add_ons.description: Comma-separated add-ons: email_checks_deliverability, email_checks_age, litigator_checks (extra charge).

source_id.description: Groups queries by source, campaign or channel; up to 255 characters of letters, numbers, spaces and . _ - : / | #. An invalid value is dropped, not an error.

notes: Name and phone are required; the more of email, address and IP you send, the more grades come back.
